prompt: When every CI check on a pull request is failing, gh pr view and gh pr status used to summarize the checks line as "× All checks failing", but now they print a count like "× 3/3 checks failing" instead. The summary should still say "All checks failing" when the failing count equals the total.

setup_replacements.new: summary = cs.Redf("× %d/%d checks failing", checks.Failing, checks.Total)
